items.title: How cutting-edge prosthetics can help probe the human mind
items.summary: Over the last few weeks, I’ve been talking to Alexander (Avi) Davidson. There are a lot of remarkable things about Avi. items.title: pCloud Password Manager Hit by Cyber Attack Involving Email Address Exposure and Login Attempts
items.summary:
Cross-platform password manager pCloud Pass has confirmed it was targeted by a cyber attack after users reported seeing unknown devices being connected to their accounts.

items.title: Suspected Vietnam-Linked Hackers Target Southeast Asia in South China Sea Espionage Campaign
items.summary:

items.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control
items.summary:
